signed_phase_projector.signed_gram_relation: S = A A^T satisfies S^2 = 160 S exactly.

closed_forms.signed_projection: A A^T / 160 is an exact rank-81 projector.

theorem: Minimal Logical 3-adic Overlap Theorem. For the projective minimal logical incidence matrix U of the W(3,3) edge CSS code, each X-ray is incident with 81 Z-rays, and pairwise X-ray visibility overlaps are only 1, 3, 9, and 27. Per row, the multiplicities are 81, 54, 18, and 6 respectively. Thus the unsigned minimal logical surface forms a 3-adic overlap scheme; the signed phase refinement simultaneously gives the exact rank-81 projector A A^T / 160.
honesty_boundary: This proves an exact finite overlap scheme. It does not by itself assign physical probabilities or continuum dynamics.
